title: Editor: rooms that play in order
summary: In the editor, a room's sub-variants can now be set to appear in a set order, to show up only once for each player, or to get rarer or commoner after a player has seen them a few times.
highlights: Order: pick which sub-variant comes first, second and so on
Seen again: let a sub-variant appear just once per player
After visits: change how often it appears once a player has been there enough times
